data.name: Aali
data.gender_notes: Aali is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is exalted or noble. The name Aali carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Aali usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a person who is highly regarded, respected and admired
data.etymology: Aali belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aali total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عالی
in_arabic.meaning: عالی معنی: بلند مرتبہ، عالی شان، پرہیزگار
in_arabic.long_meaning: عالی نام کی تفصیل: یہ نام عال (ʿāl) سے مشتق ہے جو کہ علو (ʿ-l-w) کے اصل سے آیا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بلند مرتبہ، عالی شان، یا پرہیزگار۔ قرآن کریم میں یہ جڑ متعدد بار استعمال ہوئی ہے، خاص طور پر سورة آل عمران میں۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی گولڈن ایج کے دوران عرب اور فارس کے اشرافیہ میں مشہور تھا۔ آج کے دور میں، یہ نام اسلامی دنیا بھر میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر عرب اور فارسی بولنے والے ممالک میں۔

in_urdu.name: عالی
in_urdu.meaning: عالی کا مطلب: بلند مرتبہ، عالی شان، پرہیزگار شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: عالی نام کی تفصیل: یہ نام عربی جڑ ع-l-w سے مشتق ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند مرتبہ یا عالی شان۔ اردو میں، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا کے مسلم معاشرے میں بہت مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔ اس نام کے افراد کو اکثر عظیم کردار اور روحانی اہمیت کے حامل کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام مغلوں اور پمپولا کے ادوار کے دوران مقبول تھا۔

in_hindi.name: आली
in_hindi.meaning: आली का अर्थ: उच्च पद, उत्तम चरित्र, धार्मिक व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: आली नाम का विवरण: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, विशेष रूप से ع-l-w जड़ से। इसका अर्थ है उच्च पद या उत्तम चरित्र। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बहुत लोकप्रिय है, खासकर भारत और अन्य दक्षिण एशियाई देशों में। इस नाम के लोग अक्सर महान चरित्र और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के धारक के रूप में देखे जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: عالی
in_pashto.meaning: عالی معنی: لوړ رتبه، عالی شان، پاك او پرہیزګار
in_pashto.long_meaning: عالی نوم تفصیل: دا نوم د عربی ژبې د ع-l-w ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې معنی یې لوړ رتبه یا عالی شان دی. په افغانستان او پاکستان کې، دا نوم ډیر مشهور دی، په ځانګړي ډول د پښتنو او نورو قومونو په منځ کې. دا نوم د لوی درناوي او روحاني ارزښت لرونکي کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Aali
in_english.meaning: Aali means: exalted, elevated, noble, or sublime
in_english.long_meaning: Aali name details: The name Aali originates from the Arabic root ʿ-l-w, which means to be high, elevated, or exalted. This name is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing its spiritual significance. Historically, Aali has been used across the Islamic world, particularly in Arab and Persian cultures. The name signifies a person of high moral character, noble, or sublime. In modern times, Aali remains a popular name in many Muslim-majority countries, reflecting its enduring importance in Islamic tradition.

The meaning "exalted or noble" has been a source of pride and inspiration for many. It is a name often bestowed upon children with high hopes, as a wish for their future success and dignity. In historical and literary contexts, there have been numerous prominent figures with this name in Islamic history, inspiring generations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aali" serves as a reminder to live an elevated and nobel life worthy of praise and respect. It motivates and inspires individuals to strive towards excellence, integrity, and noble character. As a constant reminder, it invites individuals to connect with their inner wisdom, abilities, and potential as part of the larger human family, thereby promoting unity, compassion, and kindness. Overall, the spiritual significance of the name "Aali" is a call to seek and embody the qualities of exaltedness and nobleness, reflecting the innate dignity of the human spirit.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Exalted, Noble" symbolizes One who is exalted or noble. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aali serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of exalted, noble.
